Info

Static analysis and diagnostic linter verifying safety, sequencing, and coherence in SCARA DSL programs.

class scarajectory.core.service.dsl.linter.scara_linter.ScaraLinter[source]¶

Bases: object

Static analyzer checking SCARA DSL AST programs for safety risks and sequencing issues.

attributes:
None.
methods:
__init__ - Initializes ScaraLinter instance.

_check_pneumatics - Evaluates vacuum pump and blow-off valve state consistency.
_check_motion - Evaluates calibration prerequisites and duplicate trajectory moves.
_check_motion(*, inst: IScaraInstruction, is_homed: bool, motion_occurred: bool, last_coords: tuple[float, float, float, float] | None, diagnostics: list[ScaraDiagnostic]) → tuple[float, float, float, float] | None[source]¶

Evaluates calibration prerequisites and duplicate trajectory moves.

Parameters:

  • inst – Current motion instruction node.

  • is_homed – True if machine has been homed or calibrated.

  • motion_occurred – True if a prior motion instruction was processed.

  • last_coords – Coordinates of prior linear move or None.

  • diagnostics – Accumulator list for diagnostic findings.

Returns:

Updated target coordinates or None.

Exceptions:

None.

_check_pneumatics(*, inst: IScaraInstruction, pump_on: bool, valve_on: bool, zone_mode: str, zone_radius: float, diagnostics: list[ScaraDiagnostic]) → tuple[bool, bool][source]¶

Evaluates vacuum pump and blow-off valve state consistency.

Parameters:

  • inst – Current tool instruction node.

  • pump_on – Active vacuum pump state.

  • valve_on – Active blow-off valve state.

  • zone_mode – Active zone mode (‘FINE’ or ‘BLEND’).

  • zone_radius – Active blend corner radius.

  • diagnostics – Accumulator list for diagnostic findings.

Returns:

Tuple of updated (pump_on, valve_on) states.

Exceptions:

None.
